messages:
emma-marketing: Quick ask — need a compact hero + 3 benchmark microtiles for the "Serving Economics" webinar registration page and email.
ryan-design: Got it. Desired sizes? ratio?
emma-marketing: Hero 1200x628 for site + thumbnail, microtiles 600x400 (also stacked mobile 400x600). Keep file exports: PNG@2x, SVG, small animated GIF for social.
akira-ops: Localization heads-up: we'll need JP/KO/EN copy variants and short alt text for each asset. Legal wants <80 chars for JP/KO hero strings.
sam-ux: Content: headline "Serving smarter, not bigger" subhead "Latency vs cost across common serving patterns" one primary stat (p99) and one cost-per-1M-tokens stat. Three workloads: convo chat, embedding batches, RAG.
emma-marketing: Yes. Numbers anonymized, rounded. Also include a compact table fallback for email clients that block images.
ryan-design: Visual brief: scatter plot (latency on x, cost on y) as hero visual, with a spotlight dot for recommended config. Microtiles: consistent layout — stat header, mini sparkline, one-line caption. Use brand tokens but condensed spacing.
sam-ux: Accessibility: 2:1 contrast min for microtiles, alt text for each image, and a descriptive longdesc link pointing to webinar deck. Provide caption strings for screenreaders.
akira-ops: Delivery timeline?
emma-marketing: Initial v1 by EOD Wednesday PST, review Thurs AM, final exports Monday EOD. Can legal do a quick sweep after v1?
legal-bot: tagging legal-review.legal-team: Please review once v1 is uploaded. Deadline: Thurs EOD for compliance check.
ryan-design: I'll upload Figma v1 and include a token sheet (font sizes, spacing tokens, color names) + dev export spec. Also two layout variants: single-row microtiles and stacked for mobile.
emma-marketing: For APAC channels: shorter copy variants (we'll provide strings). Also local CTA text for JP/KO/EN. Keep hero headline <80 chars for JP/KR.
akira-ops: I'll handle localization handoff — please add copy file to figma comments or attach CSV with id, locale, string.
ryan-design: Question: do you want decorative illustrations or keep it data-forward?
emma-marketing: Data-forward. If space, small decorative grid only. Prioritize legibility at email-thumb size — drop decorations first.
sam-ux: UX note: include tiny fallback legend on hero for colors, and short caption: "Lower latency, lower cost = better serving choices" (keep copy plain language).
ryan-design: Noted. Will also produce an animated GIF (600px) with small pulse on recommended dot for social. GIF should be subtle — no autoplay text.
akira-ops: Can we get source CSV of metrics? I have to wire them into localization pipeline.
emma-marketing: Attached CSV in the thread (uploaded to drive) with anonymized values. Also added brand color tokens and webinar slide template.
figma-bot: New file created: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/serving-econ-benchcards — comments enabled.
emma-marketing: Tagging folks: @ryan-design @sam-ux @akira-ops @legal-review. Core asks: clear hero for registration, microtiles for email/social, APAC copy variants, accessibility alt/longdesc, file exports (PNG@2x, SVG, GIF), dev token sheet.
ryan-design: Uploading v1 now. Will add a short review checklist in the file: 1) legible @600px, 2) contrast checks, 3) localization slots, 4) export naming conventions.
akira-ops: After v1, I'll queue JP/KR copy for translation memory and ping legal.
emma-marketing: If tradeoffs needed, reduce chart gridlines or decorative accents before removing data labels.
ryan-design: Roger. Posting when v1 done (reacted with :thumbsup:).
legal-bot: legal-review.legal-team: Please confirm brand usage and claims. No model names or proprietary benchmarks in assets.
emma-marketing: We'll keep claims generic ("typical p99", "approx cost per 1M tokens").
sam-ux: Also add a tiny table fallback HTML snippet for email with the three metrics (stat, unit, micro caption). I'll draft it and paste in figma comments.
ryan-design: v1 uploaded: comment threads open — ping me on feedback.
emma-marketing: Thanks everyone. Priority: make the hero look good as a thumbnail on the registration page. If anything is ambiguous, tag me in Figma.
